Environmental engineer and data scientist working in the global water, sanitation and health (WASH) sector. Open Science Specialist at ETH Zurich. I develop data science training, build open-data communities, and provide consulting to help manage the world's sanitation challenges. My work spans every sector under the sun, which has made me highly adaptable and empathetic.

I lead [openwashdata](https://openwashdata.org), a global open-data community for the water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) sector, and I teach reproducible data science with R and Quarto. My background is in environmental and hygiene engineering, with field research on faecal sludge management across Uganda, Vietnam, Haiti and South Africa.
